_meta.description: Real Miro (api.miro.com) GET /v2/boards FIRST page. Offset-paginated envelope: top-level `data` (board list) plus the pagination counters `total`/`size`/`offset`/`limit` and a `links` object with `self` and `next`. `links.next` is a full URL carrying the advanced `offset` query param and is PRESENT only while more pages remain (here total=3 > offset+size=2, so a second page exists). The terminal page omits `links.next`. The current MiroClient.list_boards reads only the first page and drops boards past it; the fix follows links.next (offset fallback) to exhaustion. Doc-derived; ids/urls are placeholders.
